answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding and generating texts across a broad spectrum of tasks.

answer_3.quote: Inspired by LLM-based evaluators , we adopt four powerful LLMs that are trained with human preferences as judges to evaluate the subjective aspects of the language design. Specifically, we prompted LLMs to inspect codes in different languages that implement the same task and assess from the following aspects: readability, succinctness, convenience, in-tuitiveness, and overall score.
